title: Shared definitions
description: Types shared by the other contracts. Referenced as common.schema.json#/$defs/<name>.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. A message with any other version is rejected (HTTP 400 at ingest, DLQ at the processor).

flightId.description: Flight id. Starts with the flight's UTC start time (basic ISO 8601) so ids sort by time, then a random suffix.

ttl.description: DynamoDB TTL attribute (epoch seconds) on the `readings` and `alerts` tables. The item expires after this time.
